To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the present work has identified a novel approach to transfect double stranded DNA using a natural beta-( 1-->3)-D-glucan schizopyllan, and the transfection efficiency of this method was comparable to that of the conventional polyethyleneimine (PEI) method.
the SPG complex can be used as a gene carrier for transfecting double-stranded DNA, and that this method has a low cytotoxicity.

a novel gene delivery system, using a complex of a beta-(1-->6)-linked glucan schizophyllin and a double-stranded DNA having poly(dA) ends, was developed and the complex showed a non-toxic transfection effect on HeLa cells.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a non-viral gene delivery system using SPG, which is a natural beta-(l-->3)-d glucan, and a poly(dA) dsDNA with a poly(dA)-loop.
a novel gene transfer system that can transfect dsDNA using a protein-transduction domain and a natural polysaccharide.
the preparation and transfection of a minimal-size dsDNA gene having a poly(dA) tail on both ends, and its transfection efficiency.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
SPG can be used for the delivery of dsDNA, and that the poly(dA)-looped dsDNA is a good candidate to mimic a viral genome for the transfection of a gene.
the poly(dA)-looped dsDNA can form an efficient complex with SPG and that this complex can be used for transfection.
SPG is a good carrier to deliver dsDNA into the cells, and the dsDNA can be protected by poly(dA) and the Tat-SPGs.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the SPG complexed with ssDNA or dsDNA with the looped poly(dA) ends could be a candidate for a safe gene delivery system.

a dsDNA having a poly(dA) tail on both ends can form a complex to SPG, and the resultant complex is able to induce cellular transfection without serious cytotoxicity, and the SPG complexed dsDNA is able to induce RNAi effect.
the SPG and Tat complex can be applied to transfect dsDNAs, such as siRNA and plasmid DNA, without producing serious toxicity.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a dsDNA can be complexed with a beta-glucan and transfection can be induced by the resultant complex, which has a structure similar to a virus.
a new gene delivery system was developed that uses SPG and poly (dA) looped DNA.
SPG is able to form stable complexes with poly(dA) and poly(dT) loops, and this complex can transfect dsDNA into cells.
